upsert_records.statement: R03 Step4 owner review identifies that Habitat angled looks like a wider rectangle rather than a clearly sloping board. Static inspection confirms a real camera tilt at offset (0,80,60), about 53.13 degrees above the XZ board, but orthographic projection with no yaw leaves a flat axis-aligned rectangle. Vertical foreshortening is 0.8; when height limits Fit, compensating magnification makes width 1.25 times top-down width. Flat unshaded materials provide little additional depth information.
upsert_records.uncertainty: Diagnosis combines inspected implementation with the two owner-supplied screenshots; no new build or runtime measurement. Camera geometry is tilted, so calling it only an artificial board stretch would be inaccurate. Visual intent remains unsatisfied in this owner review; other Step4 work is not rejected wholesale, and overall acceptance is not inferred.

derivation.verification_gap: Existing angled Boolean and CellAt(CellCenter) round trips share the affine mapping; they do not prove perceived depth. derivation.recommendation: Keep top-down for exact reading; revise angled toward a visibly oblique camera with gentle perspective and slight yaw. Validate same-frame projected corners and near/far cell sizes, then rendered appearance, picking, panning, minimap, culling and action alignment. This is an Analyzer recommendation, not a newly accepted design or implementation.
